clips.caption:
Fewer people call themselves Catholic, Baptist, Lutheran, any specific faith, every single year. You've probably felt it in your own family.

Here's the angle almost nobody raises: religion has caused wars for as long as there's been religion. If fewer people identify with one, and intermarriage keeps blending households across every line that used to divide them, a whole category of conflict just stops mattering. Kevin's point isn't that this is evil. It's that it isn't an accident - it's a documented part of the plan he sat inside.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the rest of what's being engineered out of you.
